dataset.name: Sen1Floods11 v1.1 hand-labeled subset
dataset.citation: Bonafilia et al., Sen1Floods11: a georeferenced dataset to train and test deep learning flood algorithms for Sentinel-1, CVPR Workshops 2020.
dataset.label: patch is positive when at least this fraction of valid hand-labeled pixels are water; patches with <90% valid pixels are dropped

training.class_weight: inverse frequency on the training patches
training.modality_dropout_rule: on fusion models whose name ends in _moddrop, each training sample zeros optical or SAR with equal probability, with total probability equal to modality_dropout; both are never zeroed together
training.missing_eval: optical_missing / sar_missing replace that input with zeros in the normalized tensor, the same code used by modality dropout
training.std: sample standard deviation across seeds with ddof=1
training.seed_scope: each method is constructed and trained from the same seed independently of the other methods

notes: deterministic majority class of the training labels; AUROC uses a constant score equal to the training positive rate
